claims.claim: Nellie, a yawl, at anchor on the Thames at Gravesend
claims.evidence: 'The Nellie, a cruising yawl, swung to her anchor'; 'dark above Gravesend'
'the only thing for it was to come to and wait for the turn of the tide'

claims.claim: Director of Companies is captain and host
claims.evidence: 'The Director of Companies was our captain and our host'
'The Lawyer...The Accountant had brought out already a box of dominoes'
'The sun set; the dusk fell on the stream'

claims.claim: Marlow begins to tell of his time in Africa
claims.evidence: 'Africa' appears only as a childhood map ('South America, or Africa, or Australia'); river is not named
claims.fix: Marlow begins to tell of going after a steamboat on a great river for a trading Company

claims.evidence: searched Belgian, Brussels, Congo: no hits; text says only 'a Company for trade on that river'
no 'Congo' in the text; 'one river especially, a mighty big river'
'Why shouldn't I try to get charge of one?'; 'skipper of a river steamboat'

claims.claim: sees cruelty and waste at the stations
claims.evidence: 'dying slowly'; 'grove of death'; 'dying like flies here'

claims.claim: hears of Kurtz, a brilliant ivory agent
Kurtz chief of the Inner Station

claims.evidence: 'Arrows, by Jove! We were being shot at!'

claims.claim: Kurtz ill and worshipped by local people
claims.evidence: 'had been very ill'; 'getting himself adored'; 'adored him'
'The Russian'; 'The young man looked at me'; harlequin; 'adored him'

claims.claim: Kurtz dies on the voyage downriver with 'The horror!'
claims.evidence: on the steamer: 'I am lying here in the dark waiting for death'; 'The horror! The horror!'

claims.claim: Marlow tells the Intended his last word was her name
claims.evidence: 'The last word he pronounced was—your name.'
'My Intended' said by Kurtz; Marlow visits her in the sepulchral city
